value: Sequel to Giant Girl Club. Miniguy adventure with a large variety of highschool encounters and events.

When the power goes out during the club’s anniversary party (leaving everyone stuck in their tiny bodies), Nozomi kidnaps Yuu to keep as a personal toy. Yuu will have to try and make his way back to the clubroom if he ever intends to get back to full size.
Unbeknownst to them, the school's Displinary Committee has other plans for the club...

Explore a large school map with a variety of stomp escape encounters, body exploration, unaware stealth segments and interactive narrative cutscenes. Includes a huge amount of gameplay easter eggs and achievements, with many collectibles and level interactions leading to alternate cutscenes.
